interpretation.cost: Charged dependency sums are procedure costs; serialized bytes are selected-model storage, not resident memory or update latency.
interpretation.natural: Ten-series/four-collection frozen roster. Unavailable tasks remain recorded; complete-roster aggregate is undefined if any fail. Separately labeled available-case descriptions have no population interpretation.
interpretation.scope: No pooling with the three-seed exploratory gate pilot or any historical experiment; no whole-paper coverage claim.
interpretation.synthetic: New eighteen-contrast family only; approximate paired-t inference over twelve independent repetitions per law.
